caption: The drawing depicts a decorative pendant shown from three different views: back, front, and side. The pendant is primarily gold in color with ornamental details. The front view, positioned in the center, displays a fan-shaped design resembling a peacock with its tail feathers spread. The peacock is green and gold, with feathers embellished with small blue and red circular accents, as well as gemstones. Three teardrop-shaped yellow or amber-colored pendants dangle from the lower edge, attached by small chains. The back view, on the left side, reveals an oval frame with a central transparent window bordered by gold, and the same three teardrop-shaped pendants hanging below. The side view on the right shows the pendant's thickness and structural details, including the peacock head in relief and the arrangement of the hanging ornaments. A hook or suspension loop is visible at the top of each view for attachment to a chain. The drawing itself is done on a beige or off-white background, using detailed and colored ink or watercolor to illustrate the metallic, gemstone, and enamel components of the piece.
title: Brooch
